name: loop
description: Atlas-first, local-first, platform-independent project orchestration (the platform is chosen at the start): new projects start from a flow-atlas plan, every feature is built to its map and closed by flipping it to delivered, with model routing, a 20-point legal checklist, validation, owner-friendly communication and handoff continuity.

interface.shortDescription: Atlas-first delivery, starter and model routing
interface.longDescription: Activate when Loop is requested. For a new project, ask the start questions (platform included) in one message or read START.md, start the project from an atlas plan with scripts/loop-init.mjs (using the owner's template page when given) and begin building the first map straight away; build each feature to its map, prove it, flip the map to delivered, and keep the handoff current. Existing projects are inspected locally and can adopt the atlas.
defaultPrompt: Start a new project with Loop
